title: Exchange landscapes, orientation, and rigidity in the Golden six-mode conference interferometer
description: This preprint identifies what a one-particle transfer retains under unframed, oriented, and phase-calibrated port descriptions. It proves that balanced exchange spectra of symmetric conference matrices are normalized cross-Gram spectra and are cut-independent only through half-size three, making order six the unique nontrivial uniform case. For the Golden transfer it proves the exact continuous-control optimum, a Hermitian holonomy Pareto segment, squared-spectrum rigidity, and quantitative stability to the real conference orbit. Calibrated determinant-sign coding and a photonic design boundary complete the analysis.
